title: Follow a thought
when: A reflective conversation works through a tension.
story: Follow one question through a complication to a changed perspective.
picture: An evolving ribbon or an original visual metaphor carries the thought across cuts.
pace: Let pauses breathe; move the picture when the thought changes.
rules: Keep original speech and speaker identity intact when importing a recording.
Choose a metaphor from the source; the thread is an example, not a requirement.
